scope: Descriptive supplementary reanalysis of the same45 frozen trained models and existing count-generated PCs, after all45 models and both original57/prespecified53 reports are complete. No new model or native count generation. No original result or model selection changes.
required_before_numerical_targets_or_qua: Verified45 logical/47 physical native models with all independent per-cell audits and original failures retained.
Committed original57 primary and prespecified53 reports and matching infrastructure barrier.
Validate the full cohort/donor/source-hash map before any supplementary scoring.

real_reference.donor_order: Frozen fold evaluation donor order, filtered by the cohort allowlist.
real_reference.allocation: Every donor gets floor(1500/D) cells; remaining cells go to the first remainder donors in an independently seeded permutation. Exact per-cell weights1/(D*n_d) make every donor mass1/D despite rounding.
real_reference.sample: Select cells from each donor with its own predetermined stream; replacement only when donor has fewer than n_d cells, recorded. Use exactly the same real reference and weights for every method, training seed and generation replicate within a fold/cohort.
real_reference.expression_space: Original fold-specific optimization-fitted50PC coordinates; no transform refit.

generated_reference.source: Existing retained evaluation_r{rep}/stage{stage}_all_generated_PCs.npy, shape200x400x50. The resampling baseline is replayed from its original frozen fitting-row trace and cached fitting PCs, without new RNA counts or a new model.
generated_reference.allocation: For each stage, select without replacement the sum of n_d for its held-out donors from its80000 existing PC rows. Partition selected rows into the donor blocks in the same frozen donor order. Assign each row weight1/(D*n_d). This matches real and generated stage masses exactly.

metric.name: donor_matched_weighted_cell_energy_distance
metric.estimator: Weighted empirical V statistic:2*sum_i,j a_i*b_j*norm(X_i-Y_j)-sum_i,j a_i*a_j*norm(X_i-X_j)-sum_i,j b_i*b_j*norm(Y_i-Y_j). Both weight vectors are nonnegative, sum to1, and give each biological donor mass1/D within the fold.
metric.across_folds: Equal-fold mean of the five training-seed means, with two generation replicates averaged per model. Keep all15 fold/seed points per method. This is not a pooled57-donor joint coordinate-space metric.

still_required_before_execution: Implement independent weighted-distance calculation and sampling/count/weight audits with analytic synthetic checks.
Verify actual all45/both-report completion barrier; clinical metadata alone is not completion.
